meta.title: Submit the proposal with "Supply / Service Scope" empty

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the award allocation flow for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B as required by the case.
Verify that one line is selected, one of the two bidding vendors is awarded, and the proposal value is 10 × 90.
Open the proposal form after allocating the award.
Confirm that the proposal page opened.

args.goal: On the buyer's proposal form, fill every required field except Supply / Service Scope, leave Supply / Service Scope empty, click Submit Proposal, and stop when the form shows the required-field validation for Supply / Service Scope.

steps.note: Complete the proposal while deliberately leaving the target required field blank, then submit it.
Assert that the empty Supply / Service Scope field is highlighted with a required-field error.
